title: What If You Ate Nothing but Potatoes for a Year?

scenes.text: What if you ate nothing but potatoes? Two men tried it. One did it for a year.
In 2010, an American potato-industry official ate about twenty potatoes a day for sixty days. That's roughly four hundred pounds.
He lost twenty-one pounds, and his total cholesterol dropped by more than a third.
In 2016, an Australian went further. Six to nine pounds of potatoes a day, for a full year, and he lost over a hundred pounds.
Dietitians point out the catch: potatoes have almost no vitamin A or vitamin E, and little protein.
So the surprise isn't that it works for a while. It's that a diet this extreme isn't a plan. It's a stunt.

description:
What if you ate nothing but potatoes?
Two men tried it: sixty days for one, a full year for the other. Both lost weight, but dietitians warn about missing vitamins.
